title: Vietnamese Keto Noodle Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful keto noodle dish made with tofu and steamed vegetables in a Vietnamese-inspired stir fry sauce.

ingredients.name: Tofu
ingredients.notes: Extra-firm tofu, drained and cut into small cubes

ingredients.name: Quick Noodles
ingredients.notes: Keto-friendly noodles made from vegetables or low-carb flours

instructions: 1. Cook the quick noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together fish sauce, soy sauce, and sesame oil.
3. In a large skillet or wok, heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
4. Add the tofu and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
5. Remove the tofu from the skillet and set aside.
6. In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil.
7. Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and stir-fry for 1 minute.
8. Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
9. Pour the fish sauce mixture over the noodles and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes.
10. Return the tofu to the skillet and stir-fry everything together for 1-2 minutes.
11. Garnish with chopped scallions and serve hot.
